async def act(page):
    # Wait for the page to load fully
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    
    # Ensure the searchbox is filtered for 'ChatGPT' as per the URL
    searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Filter by name")
    current_value = await searchbox.input_value()
    if current_value != "ChatGPT":
        await searchbox.fill("ChatGPT")
        await searchbox.press("Enter")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for filtering
    
    # Look for project headings or links containing 'ChatGPT'
    try:
        # Try to find a heading with 'ChatGPT'
        project_heading = page.get_by_role("heading", name="ChatGPT", exact=False)
        await project_heading.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=5000)
        project_name = await project_heading.text_content()
        # Use the knowledge base function to navigate to project details
        await navigate_to_project_details(page, project_name.strip())
    except Exception:
        # If heading not found, try links
        try:
            project_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="ChatGPT", exact=False)
            await project_link.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=5000)
            project_name = await project_link.text_content()
            await navigate_to_project_details(page, project_name.strip())
        except Exception:
            # If still not found, list all headings and links to find 'ChatGPT'
            headings = page.get_by_role('heading')
            count = await headings.count()
            for i in range(count):
                heading = headings.nth(i)
                text = await heading.text_content()
                if 'ChatGPT' in text:
                    project_name = text.strip()
                    await navigate_to_project_details(page, project_name)
                    break
            else:
                links = page.get_by_role('link')
                count = await links.count()
                for i in range(count):
                    link = links.nth(i)
                    text = await link.text_content()
                    if 'ChatGPT' in text:
                        project_name = text.strip()
                        await navigate_to_project_details(page, project_name)
                        break
                else:
                    raise ValueError("Project 'ChatGPT' not found on the page.")
    
    # After navigation, wait for the project details page to load
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    
    # Click the 'Fork' button on the project details page
    fork_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Fork")
    await fork_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the fork action to complete
    await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
    
    # Task completed successfully
    return "Forked ChatGPT project successfully."
